purpose: Record current first-party Uattzy umbrella/alias evidence for E-Shore, GASGAS and UAU/EnerMia without collapsing distinct physical PUN partyIds or extrapolating secondary-source tariff grids.

metadataEnrichment.relationship: Uattzy is the public charging brand of UAU, formed from E-Shore, GASGAS and EnerMia. Preserve the distinct PUN partyIds ESH/GAS/UTZ as physical inventory identities; do not count Uattzy as a fourth independent CPO and do not supersede the partyIds unless a future authoritative inventory migration proves they have disappeared.
metadataEnrichment.tariffModel: connector/station-specific as exposed in Uattzy app/account surfaces; no current first-party universal network price proven
metadataEnrichment.tariffChannel: Uattzy app/RFID/QR/POS direct CPO channels; third-party app/RFID prices are eMSP roaming and must remain separate
proofPositive: Current Uattzy first-party site identifies Uattzy as the public-charging brand of UAU and states that UAU was formed from E-Shore, GASGAS and EnerMia.
Current Uattzy FAQ states users of the Uattzy app/account can see the tariff applied to each connector before charging and any additional costs.
Current Uattzy FAQ states prices can vary with delivered power, session duration and stall-occupation time.
Current Uattzy FAQ distinguishes Uattzy direct channels from compatible third-party apps/cards, whose prices and conditions may differ.
negativePaths: Do not promote press/observer values such as 0.57/0.67 EUR/kWh for app/RFID or 0.61/0.72 EUR/kWh for POS as a universal Uattzy network rule because the current first-party FAQ explicitly describes connector-level tariffs and variable additional costs.
Do not merge ESH, GAS and UTZ into one physical partyId for inventory counts solely because they share the Uattzy commercial umbrella.
Do not treat third-party eMSP prices as direct Uattzy CPO tariffs.
metadataEnrichment.blockage: No public first-party deterministic mapping from every ESH/GAS/UTZ EVSE or station to its current direct Uattzy price was found. The current FAQ points to connector-level pricing in the Uattzy app/account surfaces.
metadataEnrichment.resumeCondition: A public/guest Uattzy backend, QR/POS endpoint, app API or PUN payload that maps exact ESH/GAS/UTZ station/EVSE identifiers to current direct tariff components, or a new first-party tariff table with explicit universal applicability and exact power thresholds.
metadataEnrichment.confidence: high for corporate/alias relationship and fail-closed tariff classification; no rankable tariff added

consistency.result: PASS_METADATA_ONLY; three physical partyIds preserved under one commercial umbrella

canonicalMaterialization.reason: Full corrected historical replay and 88-partyId invariant validation are still required before replacing the seed.

historyAppend: Run134: reconciled current Uattzy first-party identity evidence. Uattzy is UAU's public-charging brand formed from E-Shore, GASGAS and EnerMia, but ESH/GAS/UTZ remain distinct physical PUN partyIds for inventory. Current first-party FAQ says tariffs are shown per connector and can vary by power, session duration and stall occupancy, so secondary-source fixed Uattzy grids are not promoted network-wide. No EVSE coverage was credited.
